scope: C independent neural training and common-protocol P0 evaluation; scripted data only

config.checkpoint_selection: minimum dev masked state NLL + T1 BCE + T2 NLL; earliest tie
config.state_mask: non-UNKNOWN and nonempty cutoff-valid evidence; per factor
config.t2_mask: resume true and original-goal first step not objectively completed
config.macro_classes: gold-supported classes; Q pooled by within-graph position
config.seed_aggregation: mean and sample standard deviation; not human-population CI
config.test_policy: evaluate once after all models/dev checkpoints fixed; no test selection
config.supplement_policy: v0.3 separate frozen-model diagnostic, no training or selection

limits: No real-human P1, independent calibration, LLM or MENTIS experiment.
20 seeds quantify training randomness, not 20 independent datasets.
Structured features and supplied understanding evidence; no free-text encoder.
Inherited B label disputes and A structural zero support remain unchanged.
A T2 scores conditional argmax; C T2 scores the emitted step, so a negative T1 decision counts as a missing step. Both are reported without forcing equality.
Native v0.3 only; auxiliary multi-source JSONL requires a separate semantic adapter.
Checkpoint choice uses dev only, threshold is fixed at 0.5; no test-based model selection.

seed0_neural_vs_B4_task_cluster_bootstra.failure_policy: accuracy counts failure wrong; incomplete F1/BA withheld

t2.top1_source: explicit resume_step; not unconditional joint probability
